Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You have set out the cost drivers behind your offer, and it sounds as though any adjustment needs to be defensible within your approval process. We want a fair outcome that respects your cost pressures and keeps our long-standing partnership stable. How can we balance price and payment terms to reach an agreement within your authority?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have incorporated your confirmed volume increase into our calculation, allowing us to reduce the unit price to €369.76. 

Our current offer is a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Extending the payment terms to 90 days would necessitate a higher unit price to offset the resulting financial impact. To provide you with the most favorable pricing, we propose maintaining the standard 30-day payment terms. Alternatively, at our standard terms with Zahlungsziel 30 days net, we offer a price of €369.76 per unit, no Preisgleitklausel.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You link pricing to payment timing, and Credit Control reinforces the same point—it sounds as though financing costs are central to your flexibility. We want a sustainable agreement that recognises those costs and supports our long-term partnership. How can we reconcile the financing impact with a price adjustment within your approval authority?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 365.31 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your revised offer and the confirmed volume of 6,110 units. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Our offer is a price of €373.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

The requested 90-day payment terms generate financing costs that strictly limit our flexibility on the unit price. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised offer and appreciate your willingness to move. 

In response, we can offer a slight reduction to a price of €372.71 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Please understand that the extended payment terms remain a significant cost factor that strictly limits our flexibility on the unit price. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Your account team links price flexibility to financing costs, and Credit Control separately stresses payment terms—it seems the cost of carrying receivables is the central constraint. We want a fair agreement that recognises that burden and supports our long-term partnership without reopening your internal calculation. What room do you have for a modest reciprocal price adjustment within your approval authority to bring this to a close?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 366.58 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
